remarks: 27 Raymond St blends move-in ready, in-town convenience with scale usually found farther from town. Set on a generous private feeling .36 acres, 27 Raymond offers a flat, fenced backyard and large patio at the end of a cul-de-sac neighborhood, all mere steps from town. With five en-suite bedrooms on the second floor, including a luxurious primary suite with two walk-in closets and the sanctuary of a large spa-like bathroom, an open chef's kitchen and family room, dining room, intimate living room, private office, finished third floor, and a fully finished lower level with a sixth en-suite bedroom and separate gym, this New Canaan gem checks all the boxes for convenience and low-maintenance modern living. Complete with an oversized two-car garage, spacious mudroom, and beautifully scaled living spaces, this exceptional, like-new home is just minutes from New Canaan downtown's shops, restaurants, New Canaan's brand new library and Metro North.
